items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I got a wire from him. And Patrick, who was elsewhere, he got a wire from him. Both of us. We both went to Brussels to join his orchestra.

ctx.x: So, you decided to go to Paris. Did you have anything lined up there?
